sources.citation: Castro, Andy, Brian Crook and Royce Flaming. 2010. A sociolinguistic survey of Kua-nsi and related Yi varieties in Heqing county, Yunnan province, China. SIL Electronic Survey Report 2010-001. Dallas: SIL International. 96 pp.
sources.note: Nothing. Only first-hand Kuamasi data anywhere: 545-item Songping wordlist (App. G) in narrow phonetic transcription with Chao tone numbers (fn. 9); App. G (printed p.59 = pdf p.60): 'Phonemic analysis was not carried out'. No suprasegmental discussion; the word 'accent' occurs once in the dialectal sense ('minor differences in accent and word use' among Kua-nsi villages).
